list.name: host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM obs.family_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) ORDER BY host

list.name: family
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT family FROM obs.family_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) ORDER BY family

panels.title: Top digests by CPU

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.digest_id AS digest, any(t.digest_text) AS text, sum(s.calls) AS callCount,
  sum(s.cpu_ns) / 1e9 AS cpuSec,
  sum(s.cpu_ns) / 1e9 / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) AS cpuCores,
  max(s.cpu_ns / greatest(dateDiff('second', s.window_start, s.window_end), 1)) / 1e9 AS peakCores,
  100 * sum(s.cpu_ns) / greatest(sum(sum(s.cpu_ns)) OVER (), 1) AS cpuSharePct,
  sum(s.cpu_ns) / greatest(sum(s.calls), 1) / 1e6 AS cpuMsAvg,
  sum(s.runq_ns) / greatest(sum(s.calls), 1) / 1e6 AS runqMsAvg,
  sum(s.wall_ns) / greatest(sum(s.calls), 1) / 1e6 AS wallMsAvg,
  max(s.wall_max_ns) / 1e6 AS wallMsMax,
  sum(s.bytes_out) / greatest(sum(s.calls), 1) AS bytesOutAvg,
  sum(s.bytes_out) AS bytesOut
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats AS s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT digest_id, digest_text FROM obs.mysql_digest_text FINAL) AS t ON t.digest_id = s.digest_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_end) AND s.host IN (${host:singlequote})
GROUP BY s.digest_id ORDER BY cpuSec DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: cpuCores: average cores busy over the selected time range (1 = one core; understated when data does not cover the whole range), so a short burst is diluted on a long range. peakCores: the highest rate of one flush interval on one host — sort by it to find bursts. cpuSharePct: share of all query CPU of the selected hosts. wall ≈ cpu: the query itself is expensive; runq ≫ cpu: it waited for CPU (victim); wall ≫ cpu + runq: it waited on locks or I/O. bytesOutAvg: result size per call. Whether a digest overloaded the node (needs node CPU and process families) is in mysql_report.overload_cause, see the Snapshots table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, digest_id AS digest,
  sum(cpu_ns) / 1e9 / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) AS cores
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
  AND digest_id IN (SELECT digest_id FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
                    GROUP BY digest_id ORDER BY sum(cpu_ns) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, digest ORDER BY time

SELECT digest_id AS digest,
  sumIf(cpu_ns, $__timeFilter(window_end)) / 1e9 AS cpuSecNow,
  sumIf(cpu_ns, window_end >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND window_end < $__toTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY) / 1e9 AS cpuSecWeekAgo,
  cpuSecNow / greatest(cpuSecWeekAgo, 0.001) AS ratio
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE (window_end >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
  AND ($__timeFilter(window_end) OR window_end < $__toTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY digest_id HAVING cpuSecNow > 1 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Calls per second and average latency

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, sum(calls) / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) AS callsPerSec,
  sum(cpu_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS cpuMsAvg,
  sum(wall_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS wallMsAvg,
  sum(runq_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS runqMsAvg
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND digest_id = '${digest}'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT host, sum(calls) AS callCount, sum(cpu_ns) / 1e9 AS cpuSec,
  sum(wall_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS wallMsAvg
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND digest_id = '${digest}'
GROUP BY host ORDER BY cpuSec DESC

SELECT ts, host, pid, latency_ms AS latencyMs, digest_id AS digest, query
FROM obs.mysql_slow_queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND ('${digest}' = '' OR digest_id = '${digest}')
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, host, count() AS slow
FROM obs.mysql_slow_queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, host ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, family, avg(cpu_percent_avg) AS cpu
FROM obs.family_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, family, max(rss_bytes_max) AS rss
FROM obs.family_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time

SELECT host, family, avg(cpu_percent_avg) AS cpuAvg, max(cpu_percent_max) AS cpuMax,
  max(rss_bytes_max) AS rssMax, max(processes_max) AS processes
FROM obs.family_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY host, family ORDER BY cpuAvg DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT replaceRegexpOne(toString(peer_ip), '^::ffff:', '') AS peer, service_port AS port, family,
  sum(bytes_rx + bytes_tx) AS bytes, sum(conns_opened) AS conns
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote}) AND direction = 'inbound'
GROUP BY peer, port, family ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT replaceRegexpOne(toString(peer_ip), '^::ffff:', '') AS peer, service_port AS port, family,
  sum(bytes_rx + bytes_tx) AS bytes, sum(conns_opened) AS conns
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote}) AND direction = 'outbound'
GROUP BY peer, port, family ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, direction,
  sum(bytes_rx + bytes_tx) / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) AS bytesPerSec
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

SELECT host, replaceRegexpOne(toString(peer_ip), '^::ffff:', '') AS client, sum(bytes_rx) AS bytesIn,
  sum(bytes_tx) AS bytesOut, sum(conns_opened) AS conns
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND direction = 'inbound' AND service_port = 3306
GROUP BY host, client ORDER BY bytesOut DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Snapshots (fetch one with the query in deploy/grafana/README.md)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts, host, reason, verdict,
  JSONExtractString(report, 'mysql_report', 'overload_cause', 'verdict') AS overload,
  JSONExtractString(report, 'mysql_report', 'overload_cause', 'digest', 'digest_id') AS overloadDigest,
  length(report) AS reportBytes
FROM obs.diagnose_snapshots
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
